materialAssertions.assertion: JPI nº 2 admitted DP 1041/2017 and ordered production of the assignment deed/economics after finding just cause and legitimate interest.
The 15 February 2018 Commercial Court order recognised CAM as assignee creditor, rejected LPB's litigious-credit theory and partially corrected amounts in LPB's favour.
For creditor substitution, the Commercial Court expressly relied on the AC's favourable report and presumed AC verification rather than requiring all title documentation sought by LPB.
No measurable LPB estate benefit from the later loss/termination of the DP 1041 information/retracto route has been located in the current reconstruction.
The AC sequence is described as functional/directional delivery with CAM-favourable effect, not as proof of collusion or intent.

The judge sequence is described as an active/passive intervention asymmetry with CAM-favourable effect, balanced by the LPB-favourable amount correction; improper personal bias is not asserted as established.
